info.title: CosmicForge RTC API
info.description: CF Meet Meeting Service. `/api/v1`: legacy meeting API (retained for compatibility). `/api/v2`: Phase 2 meeting domain (MeetingSpace → ConferenceSession → ConferenceParticipant → ParticipantSession). v2 errors use `{ success:false, error:{ code, message, requestId } }` with stable semantic codes.

post.summary: Join a meeting
post.description:
This is where control-plane meets real-time:
1. Validates meeting exists and is not ended
2. Creates a Participant record
3. Assigns role (host or participant)
4. Generates a short-lived LiveKit join token
5. If meeting is scheduled and start time reached, transitions it to live
6. Returns join token to client

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description:
API key management for third-party integrations.

## Usage
- Create API keys via authenticated endpoints
- Use `Api-Key: <key>` header for authentication
- API keys have usage limits and expiration dates
- Keys can be revoked at any time

## Notes
- Full API key is only shown on creation
- Third-party devs cannot access internal media servers directly
- Short-lived join tokens required for connecting to RTC infrastructure

tags.name: Chat
tags.description:
In-meeting chat with hybrid real-time architecture.

## Architecture
- **LiveKit Data Channels**: Real-time message delivery via `publishData()` and `RoomEvent.DataReceived`
- **REST API**: Message persistence and history loading for late joiners

## Flow
1. **Send**: POST /chat (persist) → LiveKit publishData() (broadcast)
2. **Receive**: Listen to RoomEvent.DataReceived for instant delivery
3. **Late Join**: GET /chat to load message history

## Notes
- Messages are **volatile** - automatically deleted when meeting ends
- Only participants with 'joined' status can send/receive messages

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
User profile management and account operations.

## Endpoints
- **GET /users/me**: Get current user profile
- **PATCH /users/me**: Update profile (username only)
- **POST /users/me/deactivate**: Deactivate account (soft delete)

## Notes
- All endpoints require JWT authentication
- Deactivated users are blocked by auth middleware
- Deactivation immediately invalidates all tokens

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Webhook management for event notifications.

## Events
- `meeting_start`: Triggered when a meeting begins
- `meeting_end`: Triggered when a meeting ends
- `participant_join`: Triggered when a participant joins
- `participant_leave`: Triggered when a participant leaves

## Security
- Each webhook has a unique secret for payload signing
- Secret is only shown once on creation
- Payloads are signed using HMAC-SHA256

## Notes
- Webhooks are user-scoped
- Delivery is async and failure-tolerant

tags.name: Meeting Spaces (v2)
tags.description: Phase 2 persistent meeting definitions. A MeetingSpace is not a live call. Owner is always the authenticated caller; meeting links/codes identify a meeting but never grant membership or roles.

tags.name: Scheduling (v2)
tags.description: RFC 5545 recurrence interpreted in the meeting space timezone; bounded, idempotent occurrence materialization.

tags.name: Conferences (v2)
tags.description: ConferenceSession lifecycle: CREATED → PREPARING → WAITING → LIVE → ENDING → ENDED (+ CANCELLED / FAILED). ENDED is reached only after provider termination (Part E).

tags.name: Members (v2)
tags.description: Persistent meeting membership (not conference participation).

tags.name: Invitations (v2)
tags.description: Hash-only bearer invitations with expiry, revocation and transactional use limits.

tags.name: Participants (v2)
tags.description: Logical conference participants (one per person per conference) and moderation. All participant ids are conference-scoped.

tags.name: Realtime (v2)
tags.description: Authorized conference event stream (WebSocket) and replay. PostgreSQL is authority; events are delivery only — recover canonical state from GET /api/v2/conferences/{id}.

tags.name: Waiting Room (v2)
tags.description: Waiting is a participant admission state. Access policy is always evaluated first.

tags.name: Organizations (v2)
tags.description: Authoritative CF organization membership used by ORGANIZATION_ONLY access. Membership is resolved server-side; clients can never assert it.

tags.name: Compatibility (v2)
tags.description: Legacy → v2 migration evidence and shadow comparison (platform administrators).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description:
Administrative endpoints for system management.

## Access
- All endpoints require admin role
- Role check is performed in each handler

## Endpoints
- **GET /admin/users**: List all users with pagination and filters
- **PATCH /admin/users/:id**: Update user role or status
- **GET /admin/meetings**: List all meetings with pagination and filters
- **GET /admin/logs**: List session logs with pagination and filters

## Notes
- Admins cannot change their own role
- Most operations are read-only
